title: Which views should the Geometry tab's picker offer first?
context: The Geometry tab only shows the shaded view. A scratch test showed curvature can be read from the viewer's stored field to 1–2 % at 48³ with a two-voxel sampling step, so geometry readouts need no solver or re-bake.

options.name: Four-view picker
options.summary: Shaded plus Curvature, Overhang, Wall thickness and Pore size, sharing one colour bar and control row. About 1–2 sessions.
pros: All four concern printability and pore geometry and are built the same way.
cons: Thickness and pore size add a shader loop, which needs a compile check on Windows.

options.name: Curvature only
options.summary: The smallest version, under a session.
pros: Quickest answer to a curvature question.
cons: The picker work gets revisited as soon as a second view arrives.

options.name: All seven views
options.summary: Also Surface direction, X-ray and Networks. About 3–4 sessions.
cons: X-ray and Networks each need their own mechanism.

recommendation: All four share one purpose and one mechanism.

settles.value: positive = convex solid, outward normal out of the solid
